dist.src: Pietrzyński et al. 2019, Nature 567, 200 (arXiv:1903.08096), abstract: 'The final distance is 49.59 ± 0.09 (statistical) ± 0.54 (systematic) kiloparsecs' (20 detached eclipsing binaries); statistical and systematic errors added in quadrature
